newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-HODGSON EXTENDS CONTRACT AT INTER TO 1999.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HODGSON EXTENDS CONTRACT AT INTER TO 1999.

text.p: English coach Roy Hodgson on Wednesday extended his contract as manager of Italian league leaders Internazionale by two years, the Serie A club said.

"Roy Hodgson has officially renewed his contract until June 30, 1999," Inter said in a statement. Club sources said earlier that Hodgson, who joined Inter last October, had turned down an offer to move to former English premier league champions Blackburn Rovers.
Hodgson, former coach of the Swiss national side, had signed a contract until June 1997.

News of his extended contract came after Inter overwhelmed Portugal's Boavista 5-1 on Tuesday night in a UEFA Cup third-round first-leg tie that virtualy ensured them a place in the quarter-finals next March.

Hodgson, whose job was the focus of media speculation earlier in the season, was quoted by Corriere dello Sport newspaper on Wednesday as saying he would stay with Inter "until 2005" if he had the chance.
